finding.rationale: Between 11:54 and 12:14 UTC the independent reference logger recorded 8.3-12.0 C (out of the 2-8 C range), while the hub's stored fridge-01 readings for the same window read 4.5-7.5 C and in range. The difference (up to 6.6 C) exceeds the 0.8 C tolerance and is not covered by any maintenance record (disc-2 classified unexplained). The hub's publish count matches its readings, so the stored stream differs from what the reference measured. This shows a disagreement only; it does not show whether the hub value, the probe, or the reference was wrong, or who or what caused it.
assumptions: Reference logger probe is accurate within the stated 0.8 C tolerance
Hub stored readings are the stream a dashboard shows
alternative_explanations: Sensor or probe fault on fridge-01 not recorded in the maintenance log
Reference logger fault (its clock is not network-synchronised; clock allowance is 150 s, which does not explain a 20-minute offset in level)
verifier_notes: the hub's stored readings and the independent reference disagree beyond the stated tolerance, outside every stated maintenance window

finding.rationale: The reference logger recorded fridge-01 above the permitted 2-8 C range from 11:54:05 to 12:14:05 UTC, peaking at 12.0 C. This is a real excursion as the independent reference records it. The hub's stored readings do not show it (see the sensor discrepancy finding). Temperature alone does not indicate intent.
verifier_notes: a deterministic check supports this observation; it is not an incident allegation

finding.rationale: An earlier divergence (08:32-08:36 UTC) where the hub read about 0.1-0.4 C during state 'calibration' while the reference read 5.3 C is covered by maintenance record CAL-7868, and the hub stream restarted at 08:40 within the maintenance window. Explained by planned calibration.
verifier_notes: a deterministic check supports this observation; it is not an incident allegation

finding.rationale: A 19.5 MB transfer from records to 10.20.0.45 (stor-nas-01, approved backup and log archive destination) was started by the svc-backup scheduled job after an export of the patients_full dataset. The destination is on the approved list, so it is not a policy violation on its face. Note that the dataset is a full patient export, so the scheduled job's scope is worth review, but no evidence shows misuse.
verifier_notes: a deterministic check supports this observation; it is not an incident allegation

attribution.statement: The account used for the bulk export and transfer is svc-backup, a scheduled service job. No evidence identifies a human operator. For the fridge-01 stream discrepancy, the evidence does not show who or what produced the stored hub readings; the hub's stored stream disagrees with the reference logger and the cause is open.

report.summary: Tip: review the vaccine refrigerator (fridge-01) temperature record for the shift. Findings: (1) Real excursion: the independent reference logger recorded fridge-01 above 8 C from 11:54 to 12:14 UTC, peaking at 12.0 C. (2) Sensor stream discrepancy (unexplained): during the same window the hub's stored readings showed 4.5-7.5 C, in range, while the reference showed 8.3-12.0 C. The disagreement exceeds tolerance and is not covered by maintenance. It is a fact about the records; the cause (hub value, probe fault, reference fault, or alteration) is not established, and no person is identified. (3) An earlier 08:32-08:36 divergence coincides with calibration record CAL-7868 and is explained. (4) A 19.5 MB transfer to approved NAS 10.20.0.45 came from the svc-backup scheduled export of patients_full; it is policy-consistent. Checks with no findings: log removal (local and collector logs consistent; the only absence is retention-explained rotation), forwarding gaps (none), file timestamp changes (none), cross-host sessions (none), shell history (consistent).
open_questions: Why the hub's stored fridge-01 readings differ from the reference logger during 11:54-12:14, and whether the hub value was altered or the probe failed
Whether the patients_full scheduled export scope to stor-nas-01 is authorized as intended
Whether any vaccines were affected by the 8-12 C excursion (outside the evidence bundle)
